scripts.postinstall: echo "Workspaces ready (install per app in next steps)."
scripts.render-build:web: node -e "if(!process.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL){console.error('FATAL: VITE_API_BASE_URL is unset; web build would bake in localhost as the API origin.');process.exit(1)}" && npm install --include=optional --workspaces && npm run build:web
scripts.render-build:api: npm install --include=optional --workspaces && npm --workspace apps/api run render-build
